title: Understanding the Intercept Term
text: In a linear regression model, the intercept term represents the expected value of the response variable when all predictors are zero. Consider how centering the data affects this term.

title: Effect of Centering on the Intercept
text: When data is mean-centered, the intercept term in the regression model represents the mean of the response variable. How does this affect the weight of the intercept term?
